title: Optimizing quantum error correction through error attribution
summary: Logical error rate is a standard benchmark for quantum error correction, providing an aggregate measure of the overall effect of physical noise. In actual QEC architectures, errors at different circuit locations can have markedly different effects on logical failure even when their probabilities are equal. Here we introduce an error attribution scheme to quantitatively characterize the influence of individual circuit components on the logical error rate and use this refined information to guide targeted intervention and design for improved QEC performance.
